items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: no more than Miele gave me

ctx.x: I don't want to interrupt you, but I don't want to miss this about you took some lessons from Lorenzo Teo, you say. He helped you with the sax or clarinet or both?
Oh no, with the saxophone. With the sax. I actually didn't take any lessons from anyone on the clarinet. You see, no more than Miele gave me.
